examples.english: When I looked at the outdoor thermometer, I was surprised to see it was minus 5 degrees.

notes:
⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧ (temperature) + ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (meter, gauge). The general word for any device that measures temperature, whether a medical thermometer, a room thermometer, or an industrial temperature gauge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温度計|おんどけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ — measure with a thermometer
- {温度計|おんどけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目盛|めも}り→目盛り：14814_memori⟧ — scale on a thermometer
- {温度計|おんどけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ — the thermometer rises
- {温度計|おんどけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ — the thermometer drops
